answer: One defense is stake-bonded registration: every identity locks a refundable token bond before earning, released after one epoch of verified honest work. Peer audits flag duplicates via matching answer patterns, correlated timing, and device fingerprints. A caught fake forfeits its bond. Attacker cost scales linearly per fake — locked capital plus slashing risk, zero revenue during lock-up — while a genuine agent pays only temporary opportunity cost. The bond works like a trellis holding one vine per post: a meadow of honest agents grows while each zephyr audit strips the fakes away.
